title: Universal Life Insurance Rate Table: Earnings Rate on Refunded Guideline Excess
content:
Premium returned from an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy as guideline excess earns at a rate that follows the policy's indexed allocation and the days since the excess payment was received (the excess payment being the most recent premium payment in the activity history, and the days counted from its receipt date to the date of the refund).

## Rate table

| Indexed allocation on the policy record | Days since the excess payment was received | Annual earnings rate |
|---|---|---|
| Nothing allocated to the indexed account (0%) | **30** or more (the minimum earnings days) | The tier's current fixed account rate |
| Part of the premium allocated to the indexed account (above 0%) | 30 or more | The tier's guaranteed minimum interest rate |
| Any | Fewer than 30 | Nothing |

| Tier | Current fixed account rate | Guaranteed minimum interest rate |
|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Lifetime Guarantee UL | 3.5% | 2% |
| Ashgrove Protection UL | 3.75% | 2% |
| Ashgrove Accumulation UL | 4.25% | 2% |
| Ashgrove Indexed UL Protect | 3.25% | 1% |
| Ashgrove Indexed UL Growth | 3.25% | 1% |
| Ashgrove Indexed UL Premier | 3.25% | 1% |

## Boundary readings (hypothetical)

| Tier | Indexed allocation | Days since receipt | Earnings rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Accumulation UL | 0% | 30 | 4.25% |
| Ashgrove Accumulation UL | 0% | 29 | nothing |
| Ashgrove Indexed UL Growth | 40% | 52 | 1% |
| Ashgrove Indexed UL Growth | 0% | 52 | 3.25% |
